column1: # pi-1 Pāli→Vietnamese plain termbase decisions (brief: ../vi-termbase-brief.md). Format: hw|sense_index TAB term TAB reason. Order of preference: (a) core term, pi-1 term list or user decision; (b) form the pi-1 translation uses most; (c) clearest plain candidate. CITATION-FORM RULE: the form follows the grammar label of the sense tag. A noun headword (nominative/accusative, including "stem and nominative") takes the standalone noun form with its nominaliser as the text uses it on its own (sự tỉnh thức, sự hoài nghi, niềm tin, sự bình thản). A headword labelled only stem / compound member / compound final, an adjective or an adverb takes the bare form (xao động, hối tiếc, tham đắm, hời hợt). Verbs and participles take the bare verb (sinh khởi) unless the Pāli tense is the point (the matrix item uppannā «đã sinh khởi», the past-participle string defining «arisen», futures with «sẽ»). «có» and the classifier «loại» are dropped unless they carry meaning (có X đi kèm, có đối tượng, có gốc rễ; loại tâm = types of mind; «và loại» = the relative yañca). The unbroken form wins over a gapped « … » form when both are attested.

# USER DECISIONS 2026-11-18: dukkha bodily pain = «khó chịu» (rails: «sự đau khổ» → «sự khó chịu» in ^1-556, ^1-1388, ^1-1404); sukha split in the senses (factor «hạnh phúc» vs pleasant feeling «dễ chịu»; rails: sukhasahagata body-consciousness ^1-443 and parallels → «dễ chịu»); vāro split (section «mục» vs bhāṇavāra «phần»). The three former open-point lines were removed: those senses now have one candidate each.
